title: Price the exact BIT chart-267 temporal split and its coded tape
body:
After the first chart-267 cut, six independent fields remain. After the second cut, five suffix rows depend on all six original fields. The five fixed receivers intersect in chart 267 and span Q^8, so a common suffix chart cannot lower those protected grade-two contacts. The exact five-transition coded word preserves the original operators but loses about 716.1377 signed units across 36 calls at the first higher trial.

Pinned #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. This changes timing and live value encoding, extending the #7881 fixed geometry. Four literal controls passed both native directions, caller, bridge and all 12 fixed ingress/egress payloads each way. Independent interpreter and price replays passed with a rejected egress edit. OpenAI Codex assisted.
